method: Read-only complete review of6748 Job module/controller/validation and metadata, followed by exact two-delta comparison and manifest verification of724C final leaf. No imports of authored helpers, WinAPI lookup/probe, syntax check, child process, rustc, Cargo, SQL, original DB hash/copy or app/browser was executed.
scope: Private diagnostic compiler ownership and the carried two-process selected-field plan; not production source or Native/performance acceptance.

resolvedStageFindings.evidence: compiler_job.py owns an unnamed kill-on-close Job configured before CreateProcessW(CREATE_SUSPENDED|CREATE_NO_WINDOW|EXTENDED_STARTUPINFO_PRESENT), assigns that still-suspended root before ResumeThread, and waits for same-root exit plus Job active0. Timeouts/errors terminate only the owned Job or still-suspended unassigned root and preserve unverified cleanup as failure. Original E27 source/review remain unchanged.

Final observe records the first same-handle root-exited and Job activeProcesses>0 state, retaining exact root creation/exit times and Job counts. The early-root validation case and future diagnostic controller both require sawRootExitedWithActiveDescendants is True. Final active0 alone cannot substitute for this branch exercise.
The private Python parent fixture now passes creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW to its child Popen; it no longer relies on no-console inheritance assumptions.
The transferred descriptor is explicitly os.close(fd) if os.fdopen raises. The raw Win32 handle remains closed on earlier identity/open_osfhandle failures.

inspectedBoundaries.result: Only explicit existing executable path and owned cwd, no shell. STARTUPINFOEX contains exactly stdin/stdout/stderr; parent inherit flags are restored in finally. Job/process/thread handles are created privately; no breakaway flags or global PID/thread/command-line enumeration.

GetProcessTimes and WaitForSingleObject use the originally returned process handle, eliminating PID-reuse substitution. creation/exit FILETIME are exact decimal strings. Cleanup requires observed root exit and assigned Job active0; same-handle signal/exit time are retained as evidence.

A180s compiler bound and5s cleanup confirmation are separate. TerminateJobObject failure, wait/query failure, pre-assignment termination failure or unresolved activity keeps cleanupVerified false, CPU release unverified and status failed. Kill-on-close is not misrepresented as observed exit. CloseHandle failures are appended as errors; controller rejects them.

Future compilation requires a hashed receipt belonging to this exact plan, exact compiler module and validation-script hashes, exactly three named passed cases, per-case hashed raw results, assignment, root exit and active0. Early-root additionally requires its intermediate descendant-live observation. Candidate binding remains explicitly unreleased and validation path/hash null.

Only create-new private marker/logs and three own Python parent/child sleep cases: normal, timeout, root-exits-before-child. A child marker plus Job total>=2 prevents a root-only pass; mismatches preserve first failure and block later compilation. These cases are authored and unexecuted.

Original DB/WAL still use same GENERIC_READ/FILE_SHARE_READ handles with exact metadata/hash/WAL0 finally verification; two create-new clones are the sole Core targets. No sqlite3/controller original SQL or source log body read. Original405MB partial-input scope is unchanged.

No new full-Snapshot serialization buffer. Exactly A baselinePulse/validCursorPulse/Details versus B same-day Snapshot; current-day candidate counts explicitly limit zero-sample claims. PrivateUsage and raw CPU counters remain descriptive with sampler/boundary caveats. Whole-helper async peak and phase endpoint peaks are not allocator maxima or whole-App gates.
